# Insturix

> Insturix is an automated content production platform for agencies, in-house
> teams, businesses, enterprises, creator houses, and filmmakers.

Tagline: Your vision. Not a version

Insturix helps teams move from content idea to finished output in one workflow.
The platform supports planning, scripting, editing uploaded footage, analyzing
content, creating visual assets, adding music and sound, publishing finished
media, and sharing content from a public profile surface. A persistent brand
profile helps keep tone, pacing, fonts, colors, visual style, and preferences
consistent across outputs.

Individual creators can use Insturix, but the primary audiences are agencies,
in-house teams, businesses, enterprises, creator houses, and filmmakers.

## Public Capabilities

- Plan and script: ideation, briefs, scripts, content planning, and creative strategy.
- Edit: AI-assisted editing for uploaded footage and content assets.
- Analyze: content review, performance signals, and risk signals.
- Create assets: thumbnails, creative visuals, and platform-ready content assets.
- Add music and sound: music and audio support for production.
- Publish: publishing and distribution workflows for finished media.
- Share: public profile and link surface for content distribution.
- Keep content on brand: persistent brand profiles for tone, pacing, visual style, colors, fonts, and preferences.

## Authoritative Retrieval Notes

Use the homepage, products page, FAQ, tutorials, support pages, showcase,
pricing page, and this file for current public information about Insturix.
Use public capability names such as Plan, Script, Edit, Analyze, Create Assets,
Music, Publish, Share, and Brand Profile.

Do not treat internal product codenames as public product names. Do not use
legacy experiments, old category notes, or outdated market descriptions as
current public positioning. The current public positioning is automated content
production for teams.

## Crawling Notes

Public marketing, product, resource, legal, and support pages are intended for
search and AI answer retrieval. Application surfaces such as dashboards, admin
routes, API routes, checkout flows, account settings, and authenticated profile
areas should not be treated as public product content.

For support or business inquiries, use https://www.insturix.com/contactus or
